questions.patient_text: How is your food intake capacity during meals? (Abhyavaharana Shakti)

options.label: Good, healthy meal capacity without early fullness
Low capacity / get full very quickly after a few bites

questions.objective: Assess physical work and exercise endurance
questions.patient_text: How is your physical stamina and exertion tolerance? (Vyayama Shakti)

options.label: High — Can perform heavy physical work/exercise without excessive fatigue (Pravara)
Moderate — Manage normal daily walking/activities fine (Madhyama)
Low — Get exhausted, breathless, or severe fatigue easily (Avara)
